messages:
Eli: Spotted two issues in the API ref: the chat/generate example mixup and a bad Python snippet in the samples page. The chat sample shows messages as an array of strings instead of objects with role/content, and the Python snippet for generate uses "max_tokens" instead of our new field "max_new_tokens". Both lead to runtime 400s / confusing SDK behavior.

June: Oof. Which files/PRs?

Eli: docs/reference/chat.md and docs/samples/generate_quickstart.md in PR #5788. Current chat example:
```json
[{"user":"hello"},{"assistant":"hi"}]
```
We need:
```json
[{"role":"user","content":"hello"},{"role":"assistant","content":"hi"}]
```
And in generate_quickstart.md the Python example shows:
```py
client.generate(model="redwood-mini", input="summarize this", max_tokens=100)
```
should be:
```py
client.generate(model="redwood-mini", input="summarize this", max_new_tokens=100)
```

Ravi: docs-bot also posted an examples-lint failure: examples-shape and param-name mismatches.

docs-bot: PR #5788  examples-lint  failed: example_request_shape and example_param_name in docs/reference/chat.md and docs/samples/generate_quickstart.md. CI logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/5788/logs

June: Plan: Eli will update the chat MD to the correct role/content shape and fix the generate quickstart Python snippet. Ravi will update the OpenAPI examples so snippet generation picks the right shapes and param names. I'll add a short migration note about max_new_tokens vs max_tokens.

Eli: Opening a tiny PR to fix both MD pages and add the migration note: "Note: the generate API uses max_new_tokens (recommended) instead of legacy max_tokens in language clients." Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5795

Ravi: I'll change specs/openapi/generate.yaml primary example to use max_new_tokens and adjust specs/openapi/chat.yaml examples to include role/content objects. Then regenerate language snippets so Python/TS docs align. Also will add a unit in examples-lint to catch top-level shorthand message arrays (i.e., array of objects missing role/content).

Eli: Local preview shows the chat example renders correctly and the Python snippet now calls max_new_tokens. Curl to staging returns 200 for both corrected examples.

docs-bot: PR #5795 opened by Eli  examples-lint pending.

Ravi: OpenAPI PR #5799 up with canonical examples and snippet regen. I included the linter test in PR #5801.

June: Once both PRs are merged we'll update CHANGELOG: "docs(chat,generate): fix message shapes and sampling param name; regenerate SDK snippets" and close the tracker.

Eli: Merged PR #5795; CI green. Thanks all.

docs-bot: PR #5799 and #5801 merged; all CI checks passed.

June: Great. Adding a follow-up to audit other quickstart pages for legacy max_tokens and shorthand message shapes. Closing this issue after the audit. :white_check_mark:
